scripts.build: pnpm --dir ../../packages/logging run build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild app.mts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --external:express --external:google-auth-library --external:mongoose --external:zod --outfile=dist/vercel-app.mjs
